vb_textbox.text: My approach was to adopt multiple strategies in choosing your gnome, I got to 850+ mushrooms (which I was happy with) in doing the following1, I only chose the smaller gnome out of the two with the pointy hat (red or purple)Then after approx 50/75 rounds2, I only chose the gnomes on the right of the screenThen again after 50/75 rounds3, I only chose the taller of the gnomes or the grey/brown coloured ones)This took me to the 200 rounds and hopefully you have a high score as wellNote, that on occasions I did get rounds with 0 mushrooms, but all in all only had these less than 20 times and stuck to the plan as aboveTake it or leave it as you preferGood luck!
